components.name: icon
components.title: Icon
components.description: Displays an SVG icon with customizable size, color, and styling. Supports icons from the Olum icon library and other SVG-based icon sets.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A clickable control for triggering an action or submitting a form. Ships six variants and five sizes, and accepts leading or trailing icons that adjust its padding automatically.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button Group
components.description: Joins related buttons into one segmented control, collapsing the borders between them. Mix in separators and plain text segments to build split buttons and toolbars.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A month grid for choosing a date, with arrows for moving between months. Supports preselected values and disabled days, and is the surface the date picker opens.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A box that toggles between checked and unchecked, plus an indeterminate state for partial selections. Pair it with a label so the text is clickable too.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: A text field paired with a filterable option list, for picking one value out of many. Filters as you type, shows an empty message when nothing matches, and can offer a clear button.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: A trigger button that opens a calendar in a popover and reports the chosen date back. Built on the calendar component, so month navigation and disabled days come along.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Wraps a control with everything that explains it: label, helper description, and validation error. Group several into a fieldset with a legend to build a whole form.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A single-line text field for short values. Handles the usual native types and carries the theme's focus ring, invalid, and disabled treatments.

components.name: input-group
components.title: Input Group
components.description: An input with addons sitting inside its border rather than beside it. Attach icons, text, or buttons at either end to build search fields, prefixes, and unit suffixes.

components.name: input-otp
components.title: Input OTP
components.description: Separate slots for entering a one-time passcode, one character per box. Advances and retreats as you type or delete, and takes an optional separator between groups.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: A caption bound to a form control, so clicking the text focuses or toggles the input. Picks up the disabled state of the control it points at.

components.name: native-select
components.title: Native Select
components.description: The browser's own select element, restyled to match the theme. Worth choosing over the custom select when you want native mobile pickers and option groups.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: A set of mutually exclusive options where exactly one can be chosen. Arrow keys move between items, and the whole group can be disabled at once.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: A custom dropdown for choosing a single option, with full control over how items look. Composes a trigger, a floating list, and optional group labels and separators.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Drag a handle along a track to pick a number. Takes a min, max, and step, and reports the value as it moves.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: An on/off toggle that applies its change immediately, with no separate save step. Comes in two sizes and reads as a labelled row next to its caption.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field for longer input. Grows to the height you give it and carries the same focus and invalid states as the input.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays visually pressed to represent an on state. Useful for formatting controls, in default and outline variants across three sizes.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: Toggles grouped into one control, either single-select or multi-select. Keeps the pressed state in a shared store so the items stay in sync.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Holds its child at a fixed width-to-height ratio however wide the container gets. Keeps images and embeds from shifting the layout as they load.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A bordered surface that groups related content into header, body, and footer regions. Title, description, and a corner action slot are all separate pieces you compose.

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: Panels split by handles the reader can drag to redistribute space. Works horizontally or vertically and nests for split-pane layouts.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: A region that scrolls its overflow behind a styled scrollbar instead of the browser's. Keeps long lists inside a fixed footprint.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: A one-pixel rule dividing content, horizontally or vertically. Sizes itself to its container so it works in stacks and toolbars alike.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: Sidebar
components.description: A full application sidebar that collapses to an icon rail and remembers its state. Composes header, footer, and grouped menu sections, with a trigger and an inset content area.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: The trail of pages leading to the one you're on, with the current page marked. Long trails can collapse behind an ellipsis.

components.name: command
components.title: Command
components.description: A searchable palette of commands, usable inline or as a modal dialog. Filters items as you type across grouped sections, with shortcut hints and an empty state.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: A horizontal row of application menus, the kind that runs along the top of a desktop app. Each menu opens a dropdown, and moving sideways moves between them.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.title: Navigation Menu
components.description: A site navigation bar whose items open rich panels rather than plain lists. Suited to headers that need to show grouped links and descriptions.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Page number links with previous and next controls for stepping through results. Wide ranges collapse behind an ellipsis to keep the row short.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switches between panels that share the same space, one visible at a time. Arrow keys move between tabs and only the active panel renders.

components.name: anchor
components.title: Anchor
components.description: An anchor styled as a button, for navigation that should look like an action. Takes the same variants and sizes as Button, and works with a router `to` path or a plain href.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm something consequential, with explicit confirm and cancel actions. Unlike a dialog it can't be dismissed by clicking away.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: A menu opened by right-clicking its target, at the pointer. Takes the same item types as the dropdown menu.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal window layered over the page, for focused tasks and forms. Escape and a click outside both close it, and the page behind is blurred while it's open.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen and can be dragged shut. A better fit than a dialog on narrow screens.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: A menu of actions opened from a trigger, supporting checkbox and radio items, nested submenus, labels, and shortcut hints. The base for the menubar and context menu.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover Card
components.description: A preview card that appears when a link is hovered, for showing detail without a click. Opens after a short delay so it doesn't flicker in passing.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger, for anything richer than a tooltip. Composes its own title and description, and closes on Escape or an outside click.

components.name: sheet
components.title: Sheet
components.description: A side panel for secondary content or forms, entering from any of the four edges. Composes header, footer, and a close control.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A short label revealed on hover or keyboard focus, for naming an unlabelled control. A provider shares the open delay across every tooltip on the page.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: A callout that draws attention to a message in place, rather than interrupting like a dialog. Composes an icon, title, description, and an optional action.

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty
components.description: The placeholder shown when there's nothing to display yet. Composes media, a title, a description, and a call to action for first-run and no-results states.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: A bar showing how far along a known-length task is. Give it a value from 0 to 100 and it fills accordingly.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A muted shape standing in for content that hasn't loaded. Match it to the real layout so nothing jumps when the data arrives.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: An indeterminate loading indicator for waits of unknown length. Inherits the current text colour and scales with whatever size class you give it.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A brief message that appears in a corner and dismisses itself. Fired from anywhere by calling the toast helper, in success, error, warning, and info flavours, or made persistent.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Stacked headings that each expand to reveal a section of content. Configure it so one panel opens at a time or several stay open at once.

components.name: attachment
components.title: Attachment
components.description: A file attachment rendered as a row with its name, size, and a thumbnail or type icon. Add actions for downloading or removing, and group several together.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A user's image, falling back to their initials when it's missing or slow. Stack several into a group with an overflow count, and mark presence with a badge.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A small label for status, counts, and categories. Six variants, and it accepts a leading or trailing icon that sizes itself to the text.

components.name: bubble
components.title: Bubble
components.description: A chat message bubble, grouped and aligned by who sent it. The building block for conversation views.

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: A horizontally scrolling set of slides with previous and next controls. Snaps between items and keeps its position in a shared store.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.description: Bar, line, area, donut, radial, and composed charts drawn as plain inline SVG, with no charting library. All six read the same data and config shape, and take their colours from the theme.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: A region that expands and collapses from its trigger. The simpler single-section counterpart to the accordion.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data Table
components.description: A table with sorting, text filtering, row selection, and a column visibility menu. Assembled from the table, input, button, and dropdown menu pieces.

components.name: item
components.title: Item
components.description: A row pairing media, a title, a description, and trailing actions. Repeat it in a group to build lists and settings panes without hand-rolling the layout.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Renders a keyboard key the way a manual would. Group several to spell out a shortcut like Ctrl Alt Del.

components.name: marker
components.title: Marker
components.description: Highlights or annotates a span of content, with an optional leading icon. For call-outs, inline notes, and dividers within prose.

components.name: message
components.title: Message
components.description: A chat message with its avatar, header, body, and footer. Groups consecutive messages from the same sender.

components.name: message-scroller
components.title: Message Scroller
components.description: A message list that stays pinned to the newest entry as items arrive, and stops following once you scroll up. Offers a jump-to-latest button when you've scrolled away.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: A data table with header, body, footer, and caption regions. The plain foundation the data table builds sorting and filtering on top of.

components.name: direction
components.title: Direction
components.description: Flips a subtree between left-to-right and right-to-left. Wrap part of the page to preview how components read in either direction.
